nodes.name: Receive recipe request
nodes.notes: POST /webhook/generate-recipe from the Angular app. Answers come from the "Send …" / "Reject …" nodes.

nodes.name: Validate request and identify client
nodes.notes: Validates ingredients, servings, cooks, time, cuisine and diet again and reads the client IP (IPv4/IPv6).

nodes.name: Is the request valid?
nodes.notes: false → 400 with the list of validation errors.

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ message: "The request is invalid.", errors: $json.errors }) }}

nodes.name: Reject invalid request
nodes.notes: HTTP 400: the app shows its general error dialog.

nodes.name: Check daily quota
nodes.notes: 3 requests per IP and day, 12 recipes per day for the whole system.

nodes.name: Is quota available?
nodes.notes: false → 429, the app shows "Daily limit reached".

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ message: $json.quotaReason === "ip" ? "You have used all recipe requests for today." : "The daily recipe limit of the app is reached.", reason: $json.quotaReason, quota: { remaining: 0, limit: $json.quota.limit } }) }}

nodes.name: Reject request over the daily limit
nodes.notes: HTTP 429 with the reason (ip or system).

nodes.name: Build recipe prompt
nodes.notes: System rules from the user stories plus the user input; JSON schema for the answer.

nodes.name: Generate recipes with AI agent
nodes.notes: Chef agent: creates 3 recipes as JSON text; the format is described in the system message.

nodes.name: Check generated recipes
nodes.notes: Parses the JSON answer and checks: 3 different recipes, ≥ 70 % of the fitting user ingredients, ≤ 3 extras, fitting time, steps for every cook.

nodes.name: Do the recipes meet the rules?
nodes.notes: false → 502; the request does not count against the quota.

nodes.name: Split recipes into rows
nodes.notes: One item per recipe, so the Supabase node creates one row each.

nodes.name: Save recipes in Supabase
nodes.notes: Inserts each recipe into the recipes table and returns it with its id.

nodes.name: Count quota and build answer
nodes.notes: Counts the request and maps the rows to the format of the app.

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ message: "The recipes could not be created. Please try again." }) }}

nodes.name: Report generation failure
nodes.notes: HTTP 502 if Gemini, the rule check or Supabase fails.

main.node: Reject request over the daily limit
Do the recipes meet the rules?
